mechanism: Albendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of loperamide, increasing loperamide concentrations and antimotility effects; concurrent use in helminthic infections may mask symptoms or worsen outcomes.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor for loperamide toxicity signs (abdominal distension, toxic megacolon risk) and consider alternative anthelmintics or delaying loperamide until after albendazole course completion.
